source_conflicts.pressure: Appendix A states a reactor pressure of 2 bar, while the abstract and Results and Discussion describe atmospheric-pressure operation.
source_conflicts.co2_outlet_flow_mol_h: Appendix B Table 4 lists 0.005 mol/h; the Appendix C calculation uses 0.050 mol/h.
